description: Exact ground truth (atlas_truth): Minecraft's own chunk mesh traced offline from the atlaslab quads export, in a live capture's camera

scenes.title: Exact ground truth up close: Minecraft's vanilla view of Falkreath vs its chunk mesh traced offline
scenes.note: the reference atlaslab-falkreath-near approximates (4x4x4 shapes, 4x4 tiles, no light), made exact: the real quads and sprites, smooth lighting and the lightmap from the export's sky and block light, cutout and translucent layers; what remains in the .twin.png is what the game draws besides the mesh (block entities, entities, particles, animated textures)

scenes.title: Exact ground truth to 1 km: the vanilla view (Minecraft near, today's far field beyond) vs the real chunk mesh in that view
scenes.note: beyond render distance the live picture is today's far field; the offline one is the real blocks drawn as Minecraft would draw them (light from the server's light engine, tints per column): their difference is the far field's error in the game's own view
